catalog_source.integration: independent fixed-rule rebuild; repository code is not executed or copied

source_literal_fx_units.scale: absolute price units exactly as source

scale_normalized.scale: fraction of contemporaneous comparison price or mid-band

pattern.entry: repository five-node bottom-W backward search ending with current close above upper band
pattern.exit: rolling price standard deviation below beta, with normalized candidate using std/mid below beta
pattern.position: long/cash; ignore a same-bar contraction exit immediately after entry

negative_controls: fixed asset-label permutation preserving signal persistence

portfolio.turnover: half L1 including cash from drifted holdings

promotion_gates.signal_coverage: at least 20 entries and exposure in both later windows
promotion_gates.primary_performance: positive annual return, Sharpe above 0.5, drawdown no worse than -25 percent at 50 bps
promotion_gates.stress: positive full and both later-window annual returns at 100 bps
promotion_gates.controls: candidate Sharpe exceeds all controls at 50 bps
promotion_gates.dependence: absolute correlation no greater than 0.80 to core and trend
promotion_gates.blend: 80/20 blend improves Sharpe with no worse drawdown and familywise paired lower Sharpe difference above zero
